label: About
title: About Patio Entity Section
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 531 recent saved-signal files and 164 captured links, then narrowed the page to 8 source windows around @heartslobb: patio entity and @hewarsaber: This style only makes bangers, plus 6 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Patio Entity Section: Architectural section of a nocturnal chalk room, wide low panorama with cropped foreground furniture pressing from bottom and right. Keep the back wall flatter and diagrammatic: left shrine-table clutter, central padded chair block, right dark patio-glass grid holding a pale entity silhouette. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 8 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against right patio glass panes with pale hanging cloth void, cropped foreground blue tufted upholstery and coral rim, and left lace scallop glow row.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
